Decide whether the PASSAGES give enough to answer the QUESTION.

per_query.query: How do holidays affect electricity load in France and Germany?

per_query.query: What role does eigendecomposition play in adapting signal processing operations to graphs?
per_query.reference: Eigendecomposition plays a key role by allowing signal processing operations adapted from traditional settings to be applied on graphs through defining a basis using either adjacency or Laplacian operators as GSOs. per_query.answer: Eigendecomposition plays a crucial role in adapting signal processing operations to graphs by enabling the definition of a graph Fourier transform (GFT) through the projection of graph signals onto the corresponding basis derived from the eigendecomposition of a graph shift operator (GSO) [2412.18501v3 §0 p.1]. This allows for operations such as filtering to be defined and implemented in the spectral graph domain [2412.18501v3 §1 p.1]. per_query.query: How can the Hilbert transform be generalized for use on graphs?
per_query.reference: The Hilbert transform can be generalized for use on graphs by interpreting it over a cycle cover created by adding a minimal number of edges to allow diagonalization of the GSO. per_query.answer: The Hilbert transform can be generalized for use on graphs by defining a graph Hilbert transform (GHT) that leverages the eigendecomposition of a graph shift operator (GSO) to project graph signals onto a basis, enabling phase analysis [2412.18501v3 §0 p.1].
